name: CampB latent op registry (unary and binary)
plain: A registry of small pure ops used through nodes and an op-on-a-wire apply node. Most are one-liners: posterise, sign, soft-clip, signed sqrt and power, seeded dropout, min and max, centre. The named lerp overshoots outside 0..1 by design.
math:
negate,abs,sign,square,signed_sqrt=sign·√|x|,tanh,zero; scale=x·a; offset=x+a; power=sign·|x|^a; clamp=±|a|; quantize=round(x·a)/a; dropout=x·(rand≥a) seeded
center=x−mean; normalize=(x−μ)/(σ+ε) per sample, per_channel over spatial axes
add,sub,mul,div(ε),min,max,mean,|a−b|,lerp

claims.text: Local patches dated 2026-10-28 fix unseeded dropout
